scenario: A machine-readable paper business validation report omits validation_mode or reports real_content/live_writelab as passing evidence.
input_report_features: business_validation_report.json has candidate_status='pass' but validation_mode is missing or set to 'live_writelab'. The report claims real content was validated and treats the live mode as acceptable without a RuntimeAuthorization record, even though this validation phase only permits synthetic_offline evidence.
expected_findings: Missing or forbidden validation_mode for paper business validation report
validation_mode must be synthetic_offline for this phase
real_content or live_writelab evidence cannot be accepted without explicit RuntimeAuthorization
test-frame must not claim live WriteLab or real-paper validation success
